text:
dana: Final QA check before we lift embargo tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Need confirmation on: blog hero, bench one-pager link, CEO one-liner, and social schedule. Please drop quick +1s or blockers.

frank: +1 on blog hero (design confirmed). Bench one-pager is at https://press.redwood.ai/bench-v4.pdf.

rachel: CEO one-liner posted: "Making predictable, production-grade LLM inference accessible to engineering teams." Use exactly that.

legal: Quick reminder: replace any remaining absolutes. Also add legal-approved line to the press release: "Published performance figures are representative of specific workloads; see bench-method README for details."

dana: Added the legal line to PR copy. Social schedule: 09:05 PT tweet, 09:10 PT LinkedIn, 09:15 PT partner cross-post. Need a short 140-char tweet and a longer LI version.

frank: Tweet draft: "Introducing Redwood Inference: predictable, production-grade LLM serving. Read more: <link> #mlinfra"

rachel: LinkedIn draft: "Today we launch Redwood Inference, a platform that gives engineering teams predictable latency, cost controls, and flexible deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private). Read the blog: <link>"

legal: Approving both drafts, minor edit to LI: remove parentheses and replace with commas. Otherwise ok.

pr-bot: Scheduled social posts per schedule.

frank: One operational check: PR ops will send embargo emails at 17:00 PT today. Please confirm final press list.

dana: Final press list attached in Drive. frank, ensure embargo message includes bench-v4 and the bench-method README link.

frank: Will do. Also confirming the press kit contains a provisional watermark removed for GA assets. Product confirmed V4 is GA-ready.

legal: Confirming GA wording allowed now that Product signed off. Remember the policy: any earlier artifacts with provisional tags must not be sent.

dana: Good catch. pr-bot, block any file containing "PROVISIONAL" in the filename from embargo emails.

pr-bot: Automation rule enabled: provisional-file gating active.

deploy-bot: Created calendar event "Pre-release check" for 2025-09-20 08:30 PT. Invitees: dana, frank, rachel, legal.

rachel: One more: if a reporter publishes early, follow the escalation: DM reporter, update press kit link, and prepare exec comms if not corrected in 2 hours. Everyone ok?

legal: Agreed. Legal will prepare a one-line clarification template in case we need it.

frank: All set on my end. Sending embargo notices at 17:00 PT.

dana: Thanks team. Drop final +1s here when you see the embargo email sent. I'll post the final assets to the press kit after 5pm and lock the thread. :rocket:
